periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Set the audit scope and requested substance use policies from City departments and the district. Only four policies came back by the end of March. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Public Safety.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Follow up with departments directly and begin comparing the policies received.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Received 11 policies and built a comparison template. Tobacco and vape rules on City property are still missing from two departments. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Public Safety, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Collect the remaining policies and complete a first-pass comparison.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Collected 17 City, district and park policies and completed a first-pass comparison. Review of tobacco and vape rules on City property is not finished because two departments have yet to respond. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Public Safety, Parks/Rec/Libraries.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finish departmental interviews, summarize gaps for the October CHIP steering group, and recommend priorities for the 2027 plan.
